chose: each waiting note carries transcript::Urgency { None < Wanted < FastTrack }, a closed ordered enum: FastTrack while its mark is live, Wanted while marked or something waits on it, else None; the pass reads it, and only FastTrack passes the give
options: a closed ordered Urgency enum on Waiting
a raw score or the bare live/marked/wanted columns for the pass to interpret
gray: a new source of urgency is a new case or a new mapping, never a number tuned; urgency through more than one edge is not built yet; see C1017
undo: drop the field; the pass gives way for every note
